statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail 20 sits in the watch band, below the block threshold, with a narrow 18:00Z-20:00Z danger window around the remaining U.S. cash hours and the closing auction.
recommendation: The narrow danger window covers the closing auction and pre-weekend flow. From 20:00Z the cash session is closed and from the 21:00Z Globex halt no Nasdaq-100 venue is open for the remainder of the horizon, so conditional Tail falls to a weekend residual.
headline: The 29,436.75 futures low holds for a full hour and VIX slips back under Thursday's close, easing Tail to 20 while the chip-led leg and hawkish repricing keep Stress elevated
body:
The structure that mattered last hour did not repeat. NQ futures trade at 29,498.25, -0.67%, roughly 60 points above the 29,436.75 low that was printed in the previous hour, and that low has now held for a full hour rather than giving way to another leg down. The Nasdaq-100 cash index is 29,423.63, -0.74%, inside a 29,383.92-29,752.78 range, and its own session low has likewise held. Last hour's reading was raised specifically because a completed retracement failed and price extended to a new extreme. This hour the opposite happened: the extreme held and price retraced off it. Tail therefore eases from 22 to 20.

The volatility surface has moved further in the same direction. VIX is 14.48, down 0.03 on the day, having come off a 14.84 session high and back below Thursday's 14.51 close. An index sitting close to its session low while implied volatility slips under its prior close is a non-confirmation, and it is the single clearest piece of evidence against a path that denies mean reversion.

The catalyst stack itself is unchanged and still uncomfortable. Chairman Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote placed price stability as the predominant focus, and September hike expectations have repriced sharply, quoted near 48% on Kalshi and closer to 60% among economists. The 2-year yield is 4.36%, about 12 basis points higher, against a 10-year at 4.73%, up roughly 6 - a bear flattener that presses directly on long-duration technology valuations. The August Chicago Business Barometer printed 47.1 against a 57.6 prior and a consensus near 58, its first return to contraction since April. Hawkish policy alongside a weakening growth signal remains a difficult combination.

What keeps this in the watch band is the concentrated character of the decline. The PHLX Semiconductor Index is 11,495.52, -3.25%, and Nvidia is 218.28, -4.25%, near its 217.90 low, while the S&P 500 is only -0.30%. Marvell fell sharply after earnings, and PayPal dropped hard on the abandoned Advent and Stripe approach, but those are single-name stories rather than index-wide liquidation. Conflicting breadth of this kind belongs in Stress, which eases to 60 as implied volatility and the semiconductor move both stabilise slightly from the prior hour.

The danger window narrows to 18:00Z-20:00Z, covering the remaining live cash hours and the closing auction. From 20:00Z only one thin futures hour remains before the Globex weekend halt at 21:00Z, which mechanically caps how far any one-way path can run from here. Confidence stays at 88: current index, futures, volatility, yield, energy, semiconductor and breadth levels were all verified directly this hour, alongside the catalyst set and the forward calendar.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment ran from EA_ON into the watch band. Tail held between 11 and 14 through Thursday's late session and the overnight with the mode consistently mixed, while Stress drifted from 47 up to 57 as the 14:00Z Jackson Hole keynote approached. Tail rose to 17 at 14:00Z as the speech printed and the first session low was set, eased to 14 at 15:00Z on an apparently completed recovery, then stepped to 20 at 16:00Z and 22 at 17:00Z when that recovery failed and price extended to a new low, with the mode turning to event/whipsaw. One hour, 10:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon has three phases. The 18:00Z and 19:00Z hours carry the set's highest readings at 20 and define the narrow 18:00Z-20:00Z danger window: the open question is whether the 29,436.75 futures low continues to hold into the closing auction, with Monday's month-end turn beyond it. From 20:00Z the cash session is closed and only one thin futures hour remains, so conditional Tail falls back under the watch band. From the 21:00Z Globex weekend halt to the end of the horizon no venue is open, conditional Tail settles at a weekend residual covering headline and gap risk, and Confidence decays steadily with distance from the last observed evidence. The next genuine price path arrives at the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, outside this horizon.

The extension that lifted Tail last hour did not repeat, so Tail eases to 20.
